overview.about: The FM Championship is a marquee LPGA event at TPC Boston in Massachusetts, one of the tour's richest regular-season stops. A strong, deep field and a championship-standard course make it a high-profile week in the northeastern United States.
overview.nextEvent: The next FM Championship is played at TPC Boston in Norton, Massachusetts. The demanding layout and large purse draw one of the strongest fields of the LPGA season.

airportTransfer: Confirm the tournament's current transport guidance for TPC Boston before booking an airport transfer.

stayGuidance: A base in Norton, Massachusetts keeps everyday services nearby; check the last leg to TPC Boston before reserving accommodation.
